The key was generated for this file — a test key with no other use, never a device's, used nowhere else in the contract. secret_key is the 32-byte seed in identity.json's encoding (standard base64); public_key is its 32-byte public key, standard base64. Per case: nonce = the challenge's 32 random bytes (nonce_base64 is how `challenge.nonce` carries them); message = prefix bytes (ASCII, 30 bytes with the trailing NUL) || nonce bytes, 62 bytes; signature = Ed25519(secret_key, message), standard base64 — what `agent_auth.signature` carries; legacy_signature = Ed25519(secret_key, nonce bytes alone), the form the server still accepts from older agents. src/agent-challenge.test.ts re-derives every value. Written by hand, not by emit: emit rewrites fixtures/ and schema/ from scratch.
